surface_mechanism_description: Ligand exchange between TMA and surface hydroxyl groups followed by water pulse to regenerate OH sites.
evidence: In the case of Cu II b-diketonate complexes require the use of hydrogen for reduction while the Cu I complexes can yield pure copper films even in the absence of hydrogen via the surface disproportionation reaction: 2Cu I L g ´Cu s qCu II L g 1. The general reaction includes two steps: deposition of metal oxide thin film and its conversion to metallic form in a separate reduction step. When H O is used as an oxygen source, these two reaction steps may be summarised as follows: M acac g qHOg ™MO s q2H acac g , MO s qHg ™Ms qHOg.
